title: Youth mental health crisis support in schools
summary: On October 9, a vote was called on a resolution encouraging state departments to name representatives to build an implementation plan with the County, but the result is not in the meeting video. The resolution cites a study of how the 2023 Maui wildfires affect survivors' health, child development, and recovery. YouthLine, a free peer-to-peer crisis line for ages 10 to 24, said it gets no County funding and relies on grants.

boards.name: Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A vote was called on the resolution, but the result is not in the meeting video.
The resolution encourages the state departments to name representatives to build an implementation plan with the County.
The resolution says the study examines how the 2023 Maui wildfires affect survivors' physical and mental health, child development, and recovery.
A testifier cited a 2023 state study finding 27% of middle schoolers statewide seriously considered suicide.
Members described Youthline, a mental health line run by youth for youth, with adult oversight.
Defer the youth mental health crisis intervention and support item: The committee deferred the youth mental health crisis support item with no objections stated.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine said it does not get any County funding right now.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine said it is funded through grants, including one federal and one state grant.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Close public testimony on the youth mental health crisis support item: The committee closed public testimony on the youth mental health item with no objections stated.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine said the service is free, confidential, and needs no parental consent.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine said Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi schools will be its outreach focus this coming school year.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine said it started running its call center on Maui in January.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: YouthLine Hawaiʻi said it is a peer-to-peer help and crisis line for young people ages 10 to 24.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The committee had two items: youth mental health crisis support, and a proposed community resilience and youth development campus.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
